zh_CN: 您现在来到了接待大厅。
en: You've arrived to the reception lobby.

zh_CN: 在第四、第五行的间隙有一堵隔断墙，将大厅划分成了白方半场、黑方半场两个部分，中心留有了两格门框。白方半场的王翼部分可以看到前台桌，后翼部分可以看到 A3 位置有一扇门。黑方半场的王翼部分是休闲区域，后翼部分 A7 位置有一个电梯。白方底线中，D1 和 E1 位置有一扇大门，黑方底线中有座楼梯，但是它被隔离带封住了。
en: Between fourth and fifth ranks, there is a partition wall divide the hall into two side: white side and black side. It leaves an entry on the center. White king side has a front desk, and the queen side has a door on A3. Black king side is a rest area, and the queen side has an elevator on A7. On white's bottom rank. there is a gate on D1 and E1. On black's bottom rank, there is a large stair, but it is blocked by the isolation belt.

zh_CN: 黑白两个半场在棋盘中指的是上下两侧。白方半场指的是第一行至第四行的部分、黑方半场则是第五行至第八行。“王翼”和“后翼”表示左右两侧，后翼指 A 列至 D 列，王翼指 E 列至 H 列。底线通常指第 1 行和第 8 行，也就是其中最边缘的位置。
en: "Black side and white side are referred to front/back side of chessboard
column4: which white side is from first rank to fourth rank
column5: and black side is from fifth rank to eighth rank. King side and queen side are also referred to left/right side of chessboard
column6: king side is from A File to D file
column7: and queen side is from E file to H file. Bottom ranks are referred to first rank and eighth rank
column8: which are on the edge of the chessboard."

zh_CN: 您在洋馆中的门口区域
en: You are in the entrance of the Mansion.

zh_CN: 黑方有A6兵、G7兵和H6兵，白方有A5兵和H5兵。D1和E1通往接待室。H4通往花园。
en: Black has A6 pawn, G7 pawn and H6 pawn. White has A5 pawn and H5 pawn. D1 and E1 to the reception lobby. H4 to the garden.
